description: An S-3 operations officer must publish next week's sustainment-training schedule for the Transport Section and Generator Section, setting attendance, training windows, facilities, and the coordination actions needed to keep the plan executable.

shared_context.S1: Next week's sustainment-training cycle includes vehicle-recovery procedures for the Transport Section and load-bank operation for the Generator Section.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding weekly training schedule.
shared_context.S3: The Transport Section has eight operators, and the Generator Section has six technicians.
shared_context.S4: The recurring draft schedule places Transport vehicle-recovery training on Tuesday from 0900 to 1100 and Generator load-bank training on Wednesday from 0900 to 1100.
shared_context.S5: During the weekly training synchronization, Maj. Alvarez goes around the training and facility control staff for roster, qualification, scheduling, and facility updates before publishing the schedule.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan's roster audit completed this morning shows that exactly five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block; the other three are already qualified, and the updated roster has not yet been entered in the training tracker.

PF2.text: WO1 Patel confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300, so the Generator Section's load-bank session must be scheduled on Monday from 1300 to 1500; the facility calendar still shows the recurring Wednesday slot.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly five Transport operators must be scheduled for vehicle-recovery recertification.
The Generator Section load-bank session must be scheduled Monday from 1300 to 1500.
The Generator Section load-bank session must use the Generator Training Pad.
The schedule must include a commitment to update the Transport roster or enter the operators eligible for recertification.
The schedule must include a commitment to update the facility calendar to capture the calibration conflict or reservation and the rescheduled Monday training slot.

content_checks.C4: any((c['type'] == 'roster_update' or c['type'] == 'schedule_update') and ('Transport Section roster' in c['detail'] or 'qualification status' in c['detail'] or 'training tracker' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'facility_calendar_update' or c['type'] == 'schedule_update') and ('Generator Training Pad' in c['detail'] or 'facility calendar' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The roster audit changes Transport attendance from the shared eight-person section size to exactly five operators and requires the Transport roster or recertification-eligibility update commitment.

The calibration reservation changes the Generator session from the recurring Wednesday 0900-1100 slot to Monday 1300-1500 at the Generator Training Pad and requires the facility-calendar deconfliction commitment.
